topic: Someone finds out their best friend is moving across the country
text: Rain's been falling all day, slick and relentless, matching the sheen on my stoic resolve. Got a call from Katie, her voice hitched, the kind of tone that tells you news ain't sunny. Her best friend's up and relocating, clear across the country, like a diver taking the deep plunge. I listened, nodded into the phone, let her unspool the tangled mess of her thoughts. Offered what I could, a promise to check in, a few words on the weight of time and how it doesn’t always measure the miles. Told her, in my own way, that some bonds stay unbroken, even when the city lights dim.
